title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1973-10-29
source: Set 2, Handheld Sony 1 point stereo mic from the 5th and 4th row sometimes standing on chair; Recorderd and transferred by Chaffe McIlhenny; Master cassette>Revox cassette deck to DAT in 1998> to Tascam P2 Flash Card in Oct 2014>Audacity>Traders Little Helper for FLAC Fingerprint creation

ai_review.summary: Atmospheric front‑stage soundboard captures a vibrant Truckin’ → The Other One sequence with clear jams and minimal crowd noise.
ai_review.review: The tape offers an intimate, ‘you are there’ feel thanks to the close‑up board source that lets the rhythm guitar dominate while still delivering clean Jerry tones and trippy jam textures. Highlights include a wild Truckin’ into an insane The Other One–Rat sequence that showcases the band’s jazzy interplay, all presented with minimal crowd distraction.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 4‑star review praises both musical performance and recording clarity; strong show highlights offset modest recording quirks, yielding a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Atmospheric front‑stage board capture with clear instrument separation; rhythm guitar is forward‑mixed but overall clean, minimal crowd noise aside from occasional repartee.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set flow praised for its jam‑heavy Truckin' → The Other One–Rat sequence and jazzy interplay, creating a cohesive, high‑energy segment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Clean, trippy guitar tone noted; enough Jerry presence despite rhythm‑guitar dominance.
